factProposals.value: The published plan.json contains no requirements and no measures, guardrails or systems, although the stories reference 18 requirement ids (REQ-001 to REQ-055).
Every story's current due_on in plan.json is 2026-09-20 and demo day is 2026-09-27, earlier than the baseline dates (2026-10-27 to 2026-11-18); 6 of 11 releases have no stories.
Story owners are written inconsistently in the plan: 'System Administrator' and 'system_administrator' appear as separate owners, as do 'system_user' and 'System'; STORY-000 has no owner.

A proposed data model of 17 tables (work_order, asset, work_order_asset, gis_sync_event, service_request, locate_ticket, workflow, workflow_step, app_user, role, user_role, audit_entry, system_setting, integration_endpoint, api_client, compliance_response, readiness_item), each citing the requirement ids that call for it. Proposed only; nothing is created.
The Command Center is a static page served from the repo root; it cannot hold a secret or reach any external system, so connection status cannot be checked from it.

decisions.statement: Leave .colaberry/plan.json exactly as the platform wrote it and show its gaps as empty states plus a Plan check page.
decisions.rationale: The platform stops refreshing a hand-edited plan.json, so patching it would block the corrected plan from arriving.

decisions.statement: Route every tab and detail page through hash URLs on a single static index.html, with .nojekyll so GitHub Pages serves .colaberry/.
decisions.rationale: GitHub Pages on a free repo serves the root; no build step is needed and every page has its own address.

decisions.statement: Load all data through one module that joins plan and progress on story id; sample data lives in assets/sample/.
decisions.rationale: Pointing the page at the running system later should change one file, not every tab.

decisions.statement: When plan.json has no agent roster, show story owners labelled as owners rather than as AI agents.
decisions.rationale: A job title is not an agent; presenting it as one would claim something that does not exist.

limitations.statement: Every system indicator is grey ('not checked from here') in real mode; the page has no way to learn a connection status.
Outcome cards read 'not measured yet' in real mode; no measurement source exists yet.
The Knowledge base chat is a keyword lookup over the loaded files, not a language model; it declines questions the files cannot answer.
The page only works when served over HTTP (GitHub Pages or a local server); opened from disk, the browser blocks it from reading .colaberry/.
